propositions: Provider construction is an inline special case branching on resolved.startswith("anthropic") inside run(), forcing new providers to add branches in the same hot function.
Introduce a per-run ProviderSession exposing provider_factory matching pydantic-ai's infer_model(provider_factory=) hook and a registry mapping provider name to builder.
ProviderSession owns lifecycle of retrying httpx.AsyncClient instances via a _closeables list, closing them all on session close as run()'s context-manager exit.
Anthropic construction moves verbatim into an anthropic builder preserving tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, loopback-proxy bypass, and per-request timeout.
This change is a pure relocation with no behavior change, landing the seam before Bedrock and OpenAI-compatible providers register additively.
An unregistered provider name must raise LLMConfigError naming registered providers rather than a KeyError, and the model_override path must build no client.
